Z3 inputs: https://zenodo.org/records/16740866/files/QF_NIA.tar.zst?download=1
Z3 commit message: nla: support p>1 in tighten_lp_upper_bound/tighten_lp_lower_bound

Generalize the LP bound-tightening functions to nonlinear powers, mirroring
propagate_value(range, v, p) but strengthening LP bounds via propagate_lp_bound
(no lemmas) and using v's existing bounds -- not its value -- to resolve the
sign for even powers. Only exact rational roots are used and disjunctive
even-power cases are propagated only when v's sign is known (joining the
dependency of v's sign bound). Wire the down-propagation path under tighten_lp
so p>1 is exercised, accumulating tightenings.

Make mpz_manager::root return false for even roots of negatives (instead of
asserting) and short-circuit n==1, so the tighten path can call it safely.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
